name: dsfd_vm_fld_m5-p4-COMMIT
purpose: el1013-s81-vmfe/B6 dsfd_vm_fe_h leaf dsfd_vm_fld at M5 (landing drain as a bit-sliced mux: lanes 0 .. 4 in on N, 5 .. 9 on S, bit-major; drained slice words out on W / E); contract dsfd_vm_fe_h_if.svh after S2 (slice words carry only non-constant bits) / S3 (clt RT 1) / S5 (flag relay, one relay tile a lane); outline 172.8 x 69.12; EXACT pin plan (io_tcl, bit-ordered by data flow). ck signed off at 833.3 ps (the VM serial clock is 1,111.1 ps: stricter).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_vm_fld u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -Irtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/vm --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/vm/dsfd_vm_fe_h.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/vm/dsfd_sp_vm.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/vm/dsfd_vm_bgq_sys.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/dsfd_vm_wfc_ep.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/ot_dsrom_mtp_link_rtt.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/ot_dsrom_mtp_link_pair.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/rtt/ot_dsrom_mtp_rstsync.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ctrl/ot_s81_engine_adapter.sv rtl/lib/ot_async_fifo.sv rtl/lib/ot_reset_sync.sv rtl/common/ot_ratio_cdc_fifo.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_fld_m5/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_fld_m5/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_fld_m5 --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_vm_fld  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: bit-sliced pin plan (lanes bit-major on N / S, drained words on W / E) on a 172.8 x 69.12 outline: no word crosses the core sideways (p1 lane-major face groups: GRT congestion 10,019 markers); p4: recipe2 pin flops and hold stages at pins, 30ps hold margin, face-pin access keepout.

reroute_reason.why_route: Prior p2 FLD route failed child_lint pin access; B9 FCN CTS found boundary dv reg-to-output -244 ps. Recipe2 places pin flops and hold stages at the actual pins, and clears above face pins.
